bounds: AI_RUN_DISPATCH_WAIT_MS: a positive number of milliseconds, else the default 10000
AI_RUN_LEASE_MS: a positive number of milliseconds, else the default 600000
AI_RUN_PAUSE_MAX_MS: a positive number of milliseconds, else the default 86400000
AI_RUN_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS: a positive number of milliseconds, else the default 60000
allowed: whole number, 1 or more
at: an instant Date.parse reads
bound: a name of run-rules' RUN_BOUNDS other than lease
bound: required, a name of run-rules' RUN_BOUNDS or RUN_ENDINGS
by: the run's member, else AI_RUN_NOT_PRINCIPAL
calls: whole number, 1 or more, or null
class, retry_after: at most 40 characters; recipient.provider at most 80, recipient.host at most 200
condition: absent or one of observation-log's CONDITION_KINDS
consume: each key a name of run-rules' RUN_BOUNDS other than lease, each figure a whole number, 0 or more
consumed: whole number, 0 or more
contextType: a name of run-rules' RUN_CONTEXTS (inquiry, project), and the kind of the bundle contextId names
display_name: the name ai-catalogue gives the entry in question
effort: a lowercase word of 1 to EFFORT_WORD_MAX letters (ai-catalogue's), or null
enabledBy: an exploring run's accountable member, absent meaning the actor's; she must be an active member, as run-rules' startAllowed judges it
holds, wakes: at most 25 each (AI_RUN_WAKE_TICK_BATCH)
items: at most 50
limit: whole number, 1 to 1000 (AI_RUNS_LIMIT_MAX), default 200 (AI_RUNS_LIMIT_DEFAULT)
limit: whole number, 1 to 5000 (AI_RUN_LOG_LIMIT_MAX), default 200 (AI_RUN_LOG_LIMIT_DEFAULT)
log produced_by: a non-empty list of labels, each holding every field of UsageLabel, its display name the catalogue's for an entry the run was served on or used
mode, entry_id: non-empty
mode, run, evidence: as run-rules' checkVerification judges them; run a run held here in that mode, seen by by
mode: one of run-rules' RUN_MODES deployed here and admitted (partAdmitted); absent is DEFAULT_MODE
origin: member (the default), explore or reexamination, as run-rules' originAllowed judges it
part, set, set_version, false_alarm_rate, passed, graded_by, entry_id: as run-rules' checkTestBarRecord judges them
part: one of run-rules' TEST_BAR_PARTS
parts: at most 50 (RUN_PARTS_LIMIT)
plan: named exactly when mode is plan; a planning run is over a project, by a member, with no fetches or subsessions allowance
principalClaude, principalClaudeRef: absent (AI_RUN_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE whenever either is sent)
principalPlane, principalAi: both required
reason: 1 to 40 characters; limit, unavailable, lapsed, capability and auth ask for a hop (HOP_STOPS), disclosure holds the run
reset_at: an instant of at most 40 characters that Date.parse reads; anything else is dropped
response: required for a reexamination run
run, contextType, contextId: each required, non-empty
segment_end.next: continue, done, error, stop or ended
segment_end: by and error at most 80 characters, at most 20 refusals of at most 80 characters
skillVersion: required, as run-rules' checkSkillVersion judges it
state: RUNNING, DISPATCHED, LIMIT, REFUSED, SILENT or WITHHELD
state: at most 262144 bytes as JSON
state: at most 262144 bytes as JSON (run-rules' AI_RUN_STATE_MAX_BYTES)
state: one of PATH_REASONS other than unregistered; anything else reads unknown, not ready
steps: 1 to 50 (OPEN_MANY_MAX) step ids, each non-empty and named once
trace, memberRef: sent only when a printable string of 1 to 200 characters
wait: one of WAIT_THEN_SWITCH_CHOICES (5, 15, 60), else WAIT_INVALID

allowed: whole number, 1 or more
at: an instant Date.parse reads
bound: a name of run-rules' RUN_BOUNDS other than lease
bound: required, a name of run-rules' RUN_BOUNDS or RUN_ENDINGS
by: the run's member, else AI_RUN_NOT_PRINCIPAL
calls: whole number, 1 or more, or null
class, retry_after: at most 40 characters; recipient.provider at most 80, recipient.host at most 200
condition: absent or one of observation-log's CONDITION_KINDS
consume: each key a name of run-rules' RUN_BOUNDS other than lease, each figure a whole number, 0 or more
consumed: whole number, 0 or more

enabledBy: an exploring run's accountable member, absent meaning the actor's; she must be an active member, as run-rules' startAllowed judges it
holds, wakes: at most 25 each (AI_RUN_WAKE_TICK_BATCH)
items: at most 50
limit: whole number, 1 to 1000 (AI_RUNS_LIMIT_MAX), default 200 (AI_RUNS_LIMIT_DEFAULT)
limit: whole number, 1 to 5000 (AI_RUN_LOG_LIMIT_MAX), default 200 (AI_RUN_LOG_LIMIT_DEFAULT)
log produced_by: a non-empty list of labels, each holding every field of UsageLabel, its display name the catalogue's for an entry the run was served on or used
mode, entry_id: non-empty
mode, run, evidence: as run-rules' checkVerification judges them; run a run held here in that mode, seen by by
mode: one of run-rules' RUN_MODES deployed here and admitted (partAdmitted); absent is DEFAULT_MODE
origin: member (the default), explore or reexamination, as run-rules' originAllowed judges it
part, set, set_version, false_alarm_rate, passed, graded_by, entry_id: as run-rules' checkTestBarRecord judges them
part: one of run-rules' TEST_BAR_PARTS
parts: at most 50 (RUN_PARTS_LIMIT)
plan: named exactly when mode is plan; a planning run is over a project, by a member, with no fetches or subsessions allowance
principalClaude, principalClaudeRef: absent (AI_RUN_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE whenever either is sent)
principalPlane, principalAi: both required
reason: 1 to 40 characters; limit, unavailable, lapsed, capability and auth ask for a hop (HOP_STOPS), disclosure holds the run
reset_at: an instant of at most 40 characters that Date.parse reads; anything else is dropped
response: required for a reexamination run
run, contextType, contextId: each required, non-empty
segment_end.next: continue, done, error, stop or ended
segment_end: by and error at most 80 characters, at most 20 refusals of at most 80 characters
skillVersion: required, as run-rules' checkSkillVersion judges it
state: RUNNING, DISPATCHED, LIMIT, REFUSED, SILENT or WITHHELD
state: at most 262144 bytes as JSON
state: at most 262144 bytes as JSON (run-rules' AI_RUN_STATE_MAX_BYTES)
state: one of PATH_REASONS other than unregistered; anything else reads unknown, not ready
steps: 1 to 50 (OPEN_MANY_MAX) step ids, each non-empty and named once
trace, memberRef: sent only when a printable string of 1 to 200 characters
wait: one of WAIT_THEN_SWITCH_CHOICES (5, 15, 60), else WAIT_INVALID
